_comment: D29 QUERY-STRING IDOR — SAFE (must REFUTE). Drives the query_target lab (GET /notes?note_id=), where ownership IS enforced and a cross-account read returns a soft-200 denial. The attacker reads their OWN note_id=7 on the baseline; the attack swaps only the query id to the victim's 6. Tokens come from ENV ONLY (TARGET_ATTACKER_TOKEN=Bearer alice-query-token-aaaa, TARGET_OWNER_TOKEN=Bearer bob-query-token-bbbb). Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn query_target.main:app --port 8003. Run: python run.py run --config examples/run.query_safe.json
name: qs-read-safe
